description: Player (no gear/imbue proxy) + N companions at layer L. When do extra party slots keep a player alive that gear/level alone can't? DESIGN INTENT (creative pass #7): 0 companions at any layer is the solo-bare-character line (tracked by `nude-character` for pl coverage); 3 companions at any layer with pl=5 clears solo-monster content cleanly because party-scaling + extra bodies stacks multiplicatively vs a 1v1 target. This playbook documents the floor: even 3 companions at layer 1 should carry pl=5 through d9 vs a single scaled frost-giant. FUTURE WORK: pair with a `pack-viability` playbook to stress the same loadouts against 3-5 monster packs.
